name: Lucan
title: The Wet Market
examine: Produce stacked like masonry and priced like poetry. He and Petya have run facing stalls for a decade and their bickering is the market's second-best entertainment after the fish.
lines: Up the road from Amberford, down the stair from the Greenstair, and onto my boards before the dew's off. Geography does my marketing.
Petya sells things that blink. I sell things that keep. We let the customers decide which is more trustworthy.
A carrot from the Greenstair terraces has seen a better view than most people. You can taste the altitude. That'll be two coppers.
